Principle 12: Married Life
Life as Newlyweds
During our early newlywed years, we did not have much money, so my wife suffered more than me because of this.
Sometimes we had many arguments because it had taken a while for us to adjust to life together.
We each had a different upbringing, and we worked hard to learn to live together happily.
Starting a Family
After two years of marriage, we had our first baby.
We worked hard to become good parents.
It was sometimes very difficult to raise our children, so we tried to read up and ask our family and friends about good parenting skills.
Over all, our children turned out pretty good.
Family Life
After I finish work, I try to spend as much time as possible with my family.
Sometimes, I am very busy after work, and this cuts into my time at home with my family.
I try to help my wife around the house as much as possible.
My wife is more involved with our children’s education, but I try to be involved by showing concern.
I try to be supportive of her and take an interest in what she does.
Spending Time with the Family
I often watch too much television, so I try to read books these days in order to learn new things.
Lately, I have been studying English.
Because I am an important part of my family, I also want to take care of my health, so I regularly exercise by myself or with my wife.
